**What users will notice.** Closing a ticket stays fast even when mail is down (ED-001,
PB-001 — the June-outage fix), and reset mails may arrive a beat later than the response
(queued dispatch, ED-003). Reset tokens in mails become long random strings instead of
32-hex MD5 (ED-002, PB-002). If OQ-001 rules for unique slugs, new near-duplicate titles
stop sharing slugs.

**What they won't.** Every response shape, status code, error body, ordering, and quirk —
the 200-`{}` missing ticket (TG-3), no pagination (TL-2), `med` not `medium`,
int-or-string priorities, the identical 403 for expired and bogus reset tokens (RC-3).
PB-005 (no UI changes) makes all of that contractual; the replay harness fails anything
else.

**Still undecided** — the open list above; briefs for each sit in `guide/briefs/`.
OQ-005 blocks the migration WO; the rest flag gates.
